title: The Azure Levy-Masters' Course
summary: The school course of the levy-masters that runs from the first collected levy to a total levy drawn from every soul in range.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Rich Harvest
summary: The school manual of the hawk that gathers a fight's whole yield high above and drops it on every foe below.

title: Canon of the Azure Apex Reservoir
summary: The school canon of the apex reservoir whose soul anchor turns incoming soul damage into soul force held at the Core.

title: The Wind-Sworn Draw Course
summary: The school course of the wind-sworn that spins every hostile force in range into one gale and draws it whole into the reserve.

title: Manual of the Oath Held Full
summary: The school manual of the full vessel that takes in force to its brim and holds it there without spilling a drop.

title: Canon of the Sworn Zenith Reservoir
summary: The school canon of the zenith reservoir that converts soul force taken at the Core and reaps it at the peak of its reach.
